meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 触发发布流水线,把新版本送上 npm 并逐一核验产物
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次发版都要手动跑工作流、还得检查构建产物是否齐全
copy.tagline_en: Trigger the publish pipeline to ship a new npm version and verify its artifacts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cut releases by running workflows and checking the built artifacts

howto.what: 选定 patch/minor/major 或明确版本号后,Claude 触发 GitHub Actions 发布流程,轮询等待完成,核验 npm 包与 GitHub release,撰写发布说明并发布到 Discord。
howto.when: 当你说出 “publish”、“release” 等关键词提出发版请求时接管;必须先给出 patch、minor、major 或明确版本号,没给就先停下来询问。

say.text: 发布一个 patch 版本
say.note: 立即触发 GitHub Actions 发布流程
按 minor 版本走完整发布流程

say.text: 用 5.0.0-beta.9 这个版本号发布
say.note: 按指定语义化版本触发发布

howto.what_en: After you pick patch/minor/major or an explicit version, Claude triggers the GitHub Actions publish workflow, polls it to completion, verifies npm packages and the GitHub release, drafts release notes, and posts to Discord.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to publish or release (e.g. saying "publish" or "release"); it needs patch, minor, major or an explicit version, and stops to ask if none is given.

say_en.note: Immediately triggers the GitHub Actions workflow
Runs the full flow for a minor bump
Triggers a publish for that exact semver
